status: Local rear-only grip implementation and standalone rendering reviewed; parent owns integrated motion verification.
summary_ko: 62도 대각선 파지를 선정하고 엄지 대향·손가락별 감김을 수정했다. 4방향 실제 렌더를 확인했으며 일반 파지 복원과 선정한 손가락 표면 검사를 재현했다. 손 전체의 완전한 충돌 없음 또는 통합 모션 완성을 뜻하지 않는다.
summary_en: Selected the 62-degree diagonal rear-only grip, adjusted thumb opposition and individual finger wrap, and reviewed four real rendered views. This records scoped surface checks and ordinary-pose restoration, not complete collision clearance or integrated-motion completion.

selection.rejected_70_degree_reason: Four fingers spread lengthwise like a climbing hand despite better blade/forearm alignment.
selection.selection_58_vs_62: Both rendered from four identical cameras; 62 degrees provided the stronger diagonal wrap and supports the parent arm alignment.
selection.refinement: Retained the original 62-degree ring/little transverse wrap, fitted thumb against the index-root exterior, and removed measured adjacent-digit triangle crossings without changing wrist/neutral/anchor coordinates.
selection.remaining_visual_limit: The index grips farther toward the guard and remains separated from the middle finger; this is a diagonal grip, not a tightly parallel vertical fist.

render.renderer: Godot 4.7 Forward+ / Vulkan, embedded display, Apple M4
render.pose: amount = 1.0; same sword/hand pose, camera only moves
render.lighting: Fixed neutral ambient plus key/fill directional lights
render.restore_scope: All source hand bone poses compared before/after amount=1 then amount=0. Upper/elbow/forearm bones excluded because the standalone preview fits the arm separately.
render.log_note: The reused render driver prints images=8 although this final invocation captures amount=1 only: actual file count is four. Restore and cursor booleans were actually evaluated.
render.input_scope: No OS window, mouse capture, hardware input, or game control validation.

check_scope.lbs: Actual exported source vertices, skin binds, weights and rig hierarchy are transformed by the serialized production digit profiles. Earlier export-versus-Godot global-pose comparison max error was 2.4915e-7. This final computation does not launch Godot.
check_scope.triangle_crossings: At the final amount=1 pose only: index-middle, middle-ring, ring-little, thumb-index, thumb-middle. Triangles are included only when all three vertices have a dominant bone in the selected digit. Non-coplanar segment-triangle intersections are counted; epsilon edges, coplanar overlap, mixed/web triangles, self-intersection within one finger and every transition frame are not covered.
check_scope.handle_approximation: Infinite elliptical handle proxy around local Y, X radius .0225m and Z radius .0154m. rho<.8 is a heuristic penetration count, not exact contact with the sword triangle mesh. Five digits have zero vertices below .8.
check_scope.palm_exception: One palm-dominant vertex has rho=.79310968 at local (.00080844,-.13288027,-.01220135); radial distance to the ellipse surface is about 3.19mm. The exact mesh clearance at that location is unverified. Do not claim whole-hand penetration is zero.

reproduce.python: Python 3 with NumPy; used the bundled Codex Python runtime.

not_verified: Parent integrated player motion in this review
